name: memorygraph-bridge
description: Extracts context during Claude Code compactions and stores it in MemoryGraph (memorygraph.dev) so agents can recall it across context boundaries.

mcpServer.title: MemoryGraph MCP server name
mcpServer.description: The name of the MemoryGraph MCP server as registered in Claude Code (e.g. 'memorygraph').

importance.title: Default memory importance
importance.description: Importance score (0.0–1.0) assigned to memories stored during compaction.

maxMemories.title: Maximum memories per compaction
maxMemories.description: Cap on the number of memories stored in a single compaction to avoid flooding MemoryGraph.

nudge.title: Post-compaction nudge
nudge.description: Append a brief note to the post-compaction messages reminding the agent to recall MemoryGraph memories.

projectPath.title: Project path
projectPath.description: Working directory path attached to stored memories as context, enabling project-scoped recall via memorygraph.dev's project_path filter.
